insight: Step 20 metrics path uses the raw branch name, so a branch with a slash (feat/x) creates a nested path that mkdir -p $SLUG does not create. Sanitize with tr / -

Rendering code/diff lines as w-full inline-block spans puts every line on one row side by side; a newline inside the span does not break them. Use block. Assert distinct getBoundingClientRect().top per line to catch it.
Asserting a transient loading state against a fast API route is inherently flaky (~1 in 3 here). Hold the response open with page.route until the assertion runs instead of deleting the coverage.

In the diff viewer, per-line spans styled w-full inline-block laid out side by side instead of stacking, putting every diff line on one row with 4x horizontal overflow. Use block for line-per-row rendering; a newline inside the span does not separate inline-block boxes.

Step 9.5 of /setup-gbrain runs `gstack-config set brain_trust_policy@$(gstack-config endpoint-hash) personal`. For a local PGLite engine endpoint-hash returns the literal string local, but the config key validator requires @<hex-hash>, so the write always fails with `key must contain only alphanumeric characters, underscores, and an optional @<hex-hash> suffix`. Use the unsuffixed key brain_trust_policy for local engines.
